text:
That life which is not mine and surrounds me,
the mystery of death, what we call death,
and the mystery of life, always open,
what we call life
in the tree, in clouds and water,
in wind and in the world that is itself without humankind,
in the immense transparency that is not spoken, but shown
in what I sought so long and now find as I return:
childhood, perhaps, childhood, our certain end,
our tale, our song, our magical awareness:
the whole of the infinite and open life.

translation.title: That Life Which Is Not Mine and Surrounds Me...
